LanguageData.DTO_ExternalAgentBridgeTip: Allow local MCP clients running as your OS user to observe this game, acquire control, delegate configured models and issue supported game orders. The bundled MCP host connects through a local named pipe.

LanguageData.DTO_ExternalNarratorReady: External narrator connected. Provider configuration is optional.
